name: Proper Dress
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God's design in their appearance, forbidding cross-dressing as it is considered an abomination to the LORD (Deuteronomy 22:5). Proper dress should reflect holiness and purity, avoiding attire that tempts lust or represents moral corruption, as seen in the warning against the seductive clothing of a harlot (Proverbs 7:10) and the admonition that lustful looks are equivalent to adultery in the heart (Matthew 5:28). Christians are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, and to resist conformity to worldly patterns, instead renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:1-2). This commitment to purity and holiness in dress aligns with rejecting the works of the flesh, including uncleanness and lasciviousness (Galatians 5:19).
